thread:
maya: Heads-up — Customer Nexify (nexify+acct@customer.com) says they were charged after a plan downgrade yesterday. They had a PO (PO-889) on file and we show a new invoice but also a card charge. Invoice INV-2029-004 for $12,345.67 shows status PAID. They claim they already paid via PO earlier in the month. Can someone triage?

taylor: Thanks — can you paste the invoice and payment ids? Also did they submit a cancellation or just a plan change?

maya: Invoice: INV-2029-004. Payment id on our side: PAY-67890 (card last4 4242). The customer says they submitted a plan downgrade on 2029-03-18 at ~09:10 UTC via the portal (support ticket 8342). They expected no charge.

ellie: pulling ledger. quick check: INV-2029-001 (PO-889) was created 2029-03-01 and marked PAID via PO (external invoice). INV-2029-004 created 2029-03-19 by monthly-billing:v2 job and then processed to PAID by payments-service retry. looks like job retried and reissued invoice despite existing PO invoice.

simon: can you grab the billing job run id and the payment webhook payload? if we have the webhook retry id we can see why payments-service accepted it. probable race where external PO invoice and local invoice both ended up in paid state.

maya: Payment webhook payload attached in ticket. billing-bot: run-id=run-2029-03-19-48, webhook-id=wh_abc123, stripe_charge=ch_1KqX... (we mask).

ellie: ok. I see payments-service accepted ch_1KqX because invoice INV-2029-004 had status OPEN at time of webhook. The ledger job reissued because the PO invoice was recorded as external and not linked to subscription id; job created a fallback invoice for the same period.

taylor: Customer wants refund asap. Ellie, can you reverse the card charge and void the extra invoice? Also confirm whether the PO invoice remains intact.

ellie: initiating refund now. Refund id REF-789-A issued to ch_1KqX for $12,345.67. I also voided INV-2029-004 in accounting (status: VOIDED). PO invoice INV-2029-001 remains PAID and linked to subscription. Note: card refunds show up 3-5 business days.

maya: shared REF-789-A with customer. they replied: "Thanks — please confirm when reversal posts so we can reconcile."

simon: short-term: I'll push a hotfix to billing job to dedupe when an external PO invoice exists for the same subscription+period. Long-term: add link table between external invoices and subscription so job won't create fallback invoices. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/2251 (will deploy after quick CI).

taylor: filing follow-up for finance to monitor bank reversal and for CS to confirm with customer once funds land. Also add customer to priority outreach.

ellie: finance: please monitor refund REF-789-A and confirm when settlement reverses. I added a ledger note and internal tag "urgent-reverse".

maya: customer updated: "we see a pending reversal on our statement but will wait for final posting." closing loop once finance confirms.

simon: quick ops note — added temporary guard in job config: SKIP_IF_EXTERNAL_PO=true. will remove after proper mapping implemented.

billing-bot: billing job run run-2029-03-19-48 marked FIXED by simon (hotfix deployed 1898765475).

taylor: thanks team. please add a retro item to postmortems if similar cases >1/week. :thumbsup:
